description: IoT Security Workshop 4 - MQTT Security vLab featuring hands-on tasks for installing, analyzing, securing, and encrypting MQTT communication. Includes Mosquitto broker, Wireshark analysis, authentication, and TLS encryption for comprehensive IoT security training.
notes: This workspace requires TASK_ID environment variable (1-4) to launch specific lab tasks. Configure 4 separate Kasm workspaces with TASK_ID=1, 2, 3, and 4 respectively. Each task focuses on different MQTT security aspects: installation, traffic analysis, authentication, and TLS encryption.
